title: Student Assessment Software (2002 - 2005)
description: I worked together with teachers to design an early learning diagnostic application that analyses why the students get the questions incorrect. Example: A student spelled 'cave' as cav, or caiv or kaav, etc... For this project, I partnered with a Sun MicroSystems consultant in order to build a MVC swing based engine with a custom networkable ISAM database.

meta.legacySubtitle: Java 1.1.8 - Java 1.2, Swing, ISAM BTree Database, MVC
